# How much does the Pro subscription cost?

The Price.com Pro subscription has a monthly or yearly fee. In the US, the subscription is $9.99 per month or $99.99 per year.

## Frequently Asked Questions

 Is it possible to integrate to my systems? 

You bet! All our licenses gives you access to the PriceEdge API, that you can use to integrate any data to/from PriceEdge. Also, its possible to manually import/export all data inside PriceEdge.

 Where will my data be hosted? 

Your data will be automatically stored in our two data centers in Dublin, Ireland. You may also request your data to be stored in our US data center in San Jose. To request this, just contact your PriceEdge representative or our support team.

 Do I get a sandbox (test environment)? 

Absolutely. We provide a free TEST environment with every domain signed-up with us. You may use it to explore, develop & test before you go LIVE.

 Does PriceEdge have an on-premise solution or is it just cloud-based? 

PriceEdge is entirely cloud-based, meaning there is no need for site visits and our software can be used instantly by remote workers.

 Are there any cancellation charges? 

No, we do not have cancellation charges. And there are no data lock-ins.

 Is EU VAT included in the pricing? 

The Prices as applicable are exclusive of EU VAT to EU Merchants and shall be charged additionally for B2C merchants in accordance with EU VAT Rules.

## FAQ - Priceagent Subscription and Credits

#### How Much Does the Priceagent Platform Cost?

Plans start at $999 USD per month and are custom quoted from there, based on how your team uses the Platform: the studies you run, the depth of analysis you need, and your level of support. Start with a free trial, then request a quote and we will size a plan to your needs.

#### Is There a Free Trial?

Yes. Sign up for a 90-day free trial of the Priceagent Platform, no credit card required. You get full access to Market Insights for the whole trial. The trial does not include credits, so to launch your own Price Check or Price Discovery, request a quote and we will size a plan to your needs.

#### How are Studies Charged?

Studies run on credits. Your plan includes a credit allowance, and you can add more as you scale. We will walk you through the right allowance when we build your quote.

A price check is one product checked on one competitor/retailer website (via an added URL), or one marketplace seller offer checked during a single monitoring cycle. 

Products × Competitor/retailer websites (or marketplace sellers) × Monitoring frequency = Total price checks

Prices in US dollars. Plans renew monthly or yearly until you cancel; Scanner Pro and the yearly plans are sold in the iPhone and Android apps. No free trial: the Free plan is the trial. The iPhone app and the Android app work on Whatnot, eBay Live and TikTok Live. The Chrome extension works on Whatnot, and on eBay Live and TikTok Live once you turn those sites on in its settings.

### How buying works

1. 01

Add to Chrome. Free, from the Chrome Web Store.
2. 02

Make a free account inside the extension. That is the Free plan: 100 priced cards a month.
3. 03

Upgrade from the toolbar popup. Scanner is $12.99 a month for 1,500 cards. The 500-card pack is $4.99, once, on top of Scanner. Cancel from the same popup.

Nothing is sold on this website. The iPhone and Android apps use the same account and the same count; on iPhone, Scanner, Scanner Pro and the yearly plans are bought inside the app through the App Store, and on Android, the same plans and the pack are bought inside the app through Google Play.
